actual_source_findings: ContentProgress.reconcile obtains registry IDs across inventory/hands/armor/active accessories. Obtained material unlocks recipe discovery only. Plain base ID does not establish functional variant identity.

crafted handler awards existing supply ID solely via EquipmentBehaviors.id(actual output); marked wine shares marching_wine baseID and ordinary supplies reward path. Dedicated variant completion cannot be inferred from this existing award.
DynastyAdvancements.award silently returns for undefined advancement. Any future dedicated receipt must register exact definition with code criterion first; no phantom completed node.

Existing infusion-table path and workbench recipe path have distinct costs/events; table first_infusion is not proof of workbench crafting. Existing workbench paths must not acquire a new jade-table prerequisite.
implementation_constraints: Preserve existing graph nodes and IDs/rewards; allocate collision-checked new IDs only after own semantic gate and design acceptance. No production edits in this contract.
Do not require ordinary tiger_claw/scale_plate as ingredients absent from these native recipes. Steel navigation must not introduce late Boss progression gate.
Current-integration graph1259/no-cycle evidence is prior static receipt; this design is not evidence of new installed graph or native acceptance.

Verify exact function tags, not display names; wrong infusion material, ordinary base, renamed base, ordinary poison potion fail dedicated variant receipt. Correct native workbench output succeeds only for actual actor; repeat crafting/login must not grant extra rewards.
Trade completion requires distinct paid trade receipt if added later; discovery/pickup/table infusion must not be recorded as personal crafting.
Recheck graph cycles/missing predecessors and actual actor/recipe/payment/native receipt once implemented; do not rerun unrelated passed projects.
